simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כִּנְעָה (H3666) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

simple.summary: כִּנְעָה (kinʻâh) means a package First listed occurrence: Jer 10 17.

definitions.full: H3666. kinah [ כִּנְעָה ] noun feminine bundle, pack (compare Arabic sense of √, above); — suffix כִּנְעָתֵ֑ךְ מֵאֶרֶץ אִסְפִי Jer 10:7 pack thy bundle (and take it) out of the land.
definitions.rootNote: from 3665 in the sense of folding (compare 3664 );
